mapping_reason: Use the positive-x, positive-y member of the four reflection-related static-admissibility mappings as a conditional coordinate convention, not an instrument registration or a fit to optical outputs.
eccentricity_rule: Arithmetic mean of the vertices of this mapping's common seven-stage admissible polygon. The pressure distribution is positive exponential tilt over the unchanged discrete jack footprint, normalized to unit resultant and the selected first moment. This specifies a conditional load, not the actual jack contact pressure.
anchor_fit_reason: Fit one diagonal stiffness contrast k_i = k_0 exp(eta sign(x_i y_i)) to the measured change of the self-balanced four-rod contrast between 25 and 50 kN. Keep geometric-mean stiffness, gravity seating, zero specified assembly tension and the previous trestle compliance. Other rod components, 75/100-kN responses, local motion and regional host outputs are checks.
